title: Pilobil.us proof of concept: author one article, publish real pages

comments.author: home
comments.text:
GOAL: the actual proof of concept - real published pages for Pilobil.us.

CONTEXT: Pilobil.us is a Papyrus pod at /Users/home/Projects/Pilobol.us (Kanbus project PILO, editorial story workflow idea->assignment->research->report->editor_select->copywriting->published). It is KB-ready but cannot publish today.

SCOPE:
1. Author at least one REAL article in Markus Markdown that exercises the interesting vocabulary - pull-quote AND a multi-column construct (card-grid or two-up) AND a figure. The whole point is to prove non-trivial constructs survive the shared schema, so a plain-prose article does not test anything.
2. Configure the publication with rendererConfig { kind: 'markus', theme: ... }.
3. Publish real static pages.
4. Then flip the SAME article to { kind: 'pretext', layout: 'newsprint' } and render it again. THIS IS THE MONEY SHOT: one source, two renderers, no second content model. Capture both outputs.

ACCEPTANCE: two real rendered outputs from one Markdown file, both openable in a browser.

DEPENDS ON: PPY-88f77b, PPY-eca592.

comments.author: home
comments.text: 88f77b and eca592 landed. Starting Composer 2.5 planning for the dual-renderer PoC. Domain is pilobol.us (not pilobil.us). Worktree at implement time: Papyrus-worktrees/PPY-10e4cd-dual-renderer from origin/feature/renderer-architecture. Do not fork a second Papyrus GitHub app.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Output A accepted. Output B blocked: this branch tracks .papyrus-production-workspace so npm run dev requires production amplify_outputs. Retrying Pretext via npx next dev plus personal sandbox outputs (ppy-6b4094 stack). Issue stays open.

comments.text: Landed on feature/renderer-architecture as e48afed (PR #63). Adapter, sample.md, Markus static path, and pilobol-sample layoutPlan (only slug sample) are on the branch to build on. Visual design is a separate track; issue stays open.

comments.author: home
comments.text:
OUTPUT B ACHIEVED. The dual-renderer thesis is now DEMONSTRATED RUNNING, not just asserted.

HOW THE ORIGINAL BLOCKER WAS BYPASSED: Output B was blocked on 'npm run dev requires production amplify_outputs'. It does not, for this purpose. lib/content-repository.ts routes loadEditionContent({scenarioId}) straight to getLayoutScenario(scenarioId) and NEVER touches GraphQL. So the scenario path renders Pretext with no backend at all. The only real requirement is that components/amplify-client-provider.tsx can resolve amplify_outputs.json; lib/amplify-outputs-guard.ts rejects only PRODUCTION-shaped outputs (graphql host '64hviw' or user pool us-east-1_40Uot7WSv). A clearly-local non-production stub satisfies it. That file is gitignored and uncommitted.

OUTPUT B - Pretext, from Markus source:
  npx next dev -p 3100  ->  http://localhost:3100/?scenario=pilobol-sample   (HTTP 200)
Renders as newsprint, masthead 'PILOBOL.US DUAL RENDERER POC'. Verified rendered text contains, from the SAME sample.md:
  - prose paragraphs intact
  - PULL QUOTE EXTRACTED to Pretext's side-channel: 'The practical breakthrough is not giving agents a bigger sandbox.'
  - card-grid DEGRADED INLINE, content preserved: 'Planning state' / 'Read-only tools. An inline code_span should not be confused with a block.'
  - two-up DEGRADED INLINE, content preserved: 'Planning state keeps risk low.' / 'Implementation state is where damage happens.'
  - callout content preserved: 'Look before you leap.' / 'Only after planning.'
NOTHING SILENTLY DROPPED - exactly the documented degradation rule.

OUTPUT A - Markus, from the same source, built by PAPYRUS'S OWN RENDERER (not a bespoke script):
  papyrus_content.markus_renderer.commands.markus_build([])  ->  web/dist/{index.html, articles/sample.html, articles/second-note.html}
  served at http://localhost:8902/articles/sample.html (HTTP 200)
Full fidelity confirmed by markup count: 3 markus-pull-quote, 1 markus-card-grid, 6 markus-card, 2 markus-two-up, 3 markus-column, 1 markus-figure.

THE MONEY SHOT: one sample.md -> two renderers. Markus renders card-grid and two-up as real multi-column layout; Pretext, which cannot express them, inlines their content and lifts the pull quote into its own side-channel. One content model, no second schema.

Both outputs are reproducible with the commands above. Closing.
